motion_and_interactions.entrance_reveals: Staggered fade-up & scale reveal (framer-motion opacity: 0 -> 1, y: 20 -> 0) with 0.1s delay increments
motion_and_interactions.floating_shoe_animation: Continuous subtle vertical levitation loop: animate={{ y: [-8, 8, -8] }} transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 6, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
motion_and_interactions.parallax_hover: 3D tilt on mouse movement across product viewport (rotateX, rotateY using framer-motion smooth spring)
motion_and_interactions.color_selector_interaction: Hover state: scale 1.15 with electric cyan ring shadow; Active state: double ring border (cyan outer + white inner ring)

header.style: fixed top-0 left-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#05070A]/80 border-b border-white/10 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive and critical element MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page high-impact dark futuristic hero section for 'Nike Air Max Plus (TN)'.
Strictly follow the dark obsidian & electric cyan theme. Do NOT use standard white backgrounds or default blue gradients.
Implement the background giant text 'TUNED AIR' with extreme scale (text-[14vw]), low opacity, and uppercase tracking.
Place the floating sneaker centrally in a dedicated product viewport card with overflow-hidden, technical crosshairs in corners, glowing radial backdrop, and floating shadow.
Render four circular color selector buttons with distinct hex colors and interactive selection states.
Render technical HUD badges (coordinates, air pressure PSI, status LED, spec lists).
Include a continuous slow marquee banner at the bottom of the hero section.
Attach all required data-testid attributes to buttons, selectors, titles, and viewports for automated testing compliance.
